source: CFLOWNETS: CONTINUOUS CONTROL WITH GENERATIVE FLOW NETWORKS
translation: CFLOWNETS：使用生成流网络进行连续控制

source: ABSTRACT
translation: 摘要

source: Generative ﬂow networks (GFlowNets), as an emerging technique, can be used as an alternative to reinforcement learning for exploratory control tasks. GFlowNet aims to generate distribution proportional to the rewards over terminating states, and to sample different candidates in an active learning fashion. GFlowNets need to form a DAG and compute the ﬂow matching loss by traversing the inﬂows and outﬂows of each node in the trajectory. No experiments have yet concluded that GFlowNets can be used to handle continuous tasks. In this paper, we propose generative continuous ﬂow networks (CFlowNets) that can be applied to continuous control tasks. First, we present the theoretical formulation of CFlowNets. Then, a training framework for CFlowNets is proposed, including the action selection process, the ﬂow approximation algorithm, and the continuous ﬂow matching loss function. Afterward, we theoretically prove the error bound of the ﬂow approximation. The error decreases rapidly as the number of ﬂow samples increases. Finally, experimental results on continuous control tasks demonstrate the performance advantages of CFlowNets compared to many reinforcement learning methods, especially regarding exploration ability.
translation: 作为一种新兴技术，生成流网络（GFlowNets）可以作为探索性控制任务中强化学习的一种替代方法。GFlowNet旨在生成与终止状态上的奖励成比例的分布，并以主动学习的方式采样不同的候选方案。GFlowNets需要形成一个有向无环图，并通过遍历轨迹中每个节点的流入和流出计算流匹配损失。目前还没有实验得出结论，表明GFlowNets可以用于处理连续任务。在本文中，我们提出了生成连续流网络（CFlowNets），它可以应用于连续控制任务。首先，我们介绍了CFlowNets的理论公式。然后，提出了CFlowNets的训练框架，包括动作选择过程、流近似算法以及连续流匹配损失函数。接着，我们从理论上证明了流近似的误差界限。随着流样本数量的增加，误差迅速减小。最后，在连续控制任务上的实验结果表明，与许多强化学习方法相比，CFlowNets具有性能优势，尤其是在探索能力方面。

source: 1 INTRODUCTION
translation: 1 引言

source: As an emerging technology, generative ﬂow networks (GFlowNets) (Bengio et al., 2021a;b) can make up for the shortcomings of reinforcement learning (Kaelbling et al., 1996; Sutton & Barto, 2018) on exploratory tasks. Speciﬁcally, based on the Bellman equation (Sutton & Barto, 2018), reinforcement learning is usually trained to maximize the expectation of future rewards; hence the learned policy is more inclined to sample action sequences with higher rewards. In contrast, the training goal of GFlowNets is to deﬁne a distribution proportional to the rewards over terminating states, i.e., the parent states of the ﬁnal states, rather than generating a single high-reward action sequence (Bengio et al., 2021a). This is more like sampling different candidates in an active learning setting (Bengio et al., 2021b), thus better suited for exploration tasks.
translation: 作为一种新兴技术，生成流网络（GFlowNets）(Bengio等，2021a;b)可以弥补强化学习(Kaelbling等，1996; Sutton & Barto, 2018)在探索性任务上的不足。具体来说，基于贝尔曼方程(Sutton & Barto, 2018)，强化学习通常被训练以最大化未来奖励的期望；因此，所学策略更倾向于采样具有更高奖励的动作序列。相比之下，GFlowNets的训练目标是定义一个与终止状态上的奖励成比例的分布，即最终状态的父状态，而不是生成单个高奖励动作序列(Bengio等，2021a)。这更像是在主动学习设置中采样不同的候选方案(Bengio等，2021b)，因此更适合于探索任务。

source: GFlowNets construct the state transitions of trajectories into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) structure. Each node in the graph structure corresponds to a different state, and actions correspond to transitions between different states, that is, an edge connecting different nodes in the graph. For discrete tasks, the number of nodes in this graph structure is limited, and each edge can only correspond to one discrete action. However, in real environments, the state and action spaces are continuous for many tasks, such as quadrupedal locomotion (Kohl & Stone, 2004), autonomous driving (Kiran et al., 2021; Shalev-Shwartz et al., 2016; Pan et al., 2017), or dexterous in-hand manipulation (Andrychowicz et al., 2020). Moreover, the reward distributions corresponding to these environments may be multimodal, requiring more diversity exploration. The needs of these environments closely match the strengths of GFlowNets. Applying GFlowNets to continuous control tasks is exceptionally challenging. In generative ﬂow networks, the transition probability is deﬁned as the ratio of action ﬂow and state ﬂow. source: Generative Flow Networks.
translation: 生成流网络。

source: Generative ﬂow networks are proposed to enhance exploration capabilities by generating a distribution proportional to the rewards over terminating states (Bengio et al., 2021b;a). Since the network only samples actions based on the distribution of the corresponding rewards, rather than focusing only on actions that maximize rewards such as reinforcement learning, it can perform well on tasks with more diverse reward distributions, and has been successfully applied to molecule generation (Bengio et al., 2021a; Malkin et al., 2022; Jain et al., 2022), discrete probabilistic modeling (Zhang et al., 2022b), structure learning (Deleu et al., 2022), causal discovery Li et al. (2022) and graph neural network Li et al. (2023). The connection between deep generative models and GFlowNets is discussed in Zhang et al. (2022a) through the lens of Markov trajectory learning. In Bengio et al. (2021b), an idea is proposed for adapting GFlowNets to continuous tasks by replacing sums with integrals for continuous variables. Malkin et al. (2022) and Bengio et al. (2021b) propose detailed balance (DB) and trajectory balance (TB) objectives, which use parametric forward and backward policies in the objective function. These new objective functions do not require evaluating the ﬂow model on multiple parents of a state, which is more efﬁcient, especially for high-dimensional environments. Malkin et al. (2022) and Bengio et al. (2021b) mentioned that these objective functions can also be used in continuous scenarios by replacing the policy likelihoods in the objective with probability densities. A possible disadvantage is that it is not easy to estimate ⟦0⟧ and⟦1⟧ in a continuous environment, since the state space is much larger than in a discrete scenario, and a small error in modeling probability densities can greatly affect the ﬁnal performance. How to combine DB and TB with CFlowNets will be a worthy future work.
translation: 生成流网络被提出以增强探索能力，通过生成一个与终止状态上的奖励成比例的分布（Bengio等，2021b;a）。由于该网络仅根据相应奖励的分布采样动作，而不是像强化学习那样专注于最大化奖励的动作，因此它在具有更多样化奖励分布的任务上表现良好，并已成功应用于分子生成（Bengio等，2021a; Malkin等，2022; Jain等，2022）、离散概率建模（Zhang等，2022b）、结构学习（Deleu等，2022）、因果发现Li等（2022）和图神经网络Li等（2023）。Zhang等（2022a）通过马尔可夫轨迹学习的角度讨论了深度生成模型与GFlowNets之间的联系。在Bengio等（2021b）中，提出了将GFlowNets适应于连续任务的想法，即通过用积分替换连续变量的求和。Malkin等（2022）和Bengio等（2021b）提出了详细平衡（DB）和轨迹平衡（TB）目标，这些目标在目标函数中使用参数化的正向和反向策略。这些新目标函数不需要评估状态多个父节点上的流模型，这在高维环境中更为高效。Malkin等（2022）和Bengio等（2021b）提到，这些目标函数也可以通过将目标中的策略似然替换为概率密度来用于连续场景。一个可能的劣势是，在连续环境中估计⟦0⟧和⟦1⟧并不容易，因为状态空间比离散场景大得多，而对概率密度建模的小误差可能会极大地影响最终性能。如何结合DB和TB与CFlowNets将是未来值得研究的工作。

source: 7 CONCLUSION
translation: 7 结论

source: In this paper, we propose generative continuous ﬂow networks to enhance exploration in continuous control tasks. The theoretical formulation of CFlowNets is ﬁrst presented. Then, a training framework for CFlowNets is proposed, including the action selection process, the ﬂow approximation algorithm, and the continuous ﬂow matching loss function. Theoretical analysis shows that the error of the ﬂow approximation decreases rapidly as the number of ﬂow samples increases. Experimental results on continuous control tasks illustrate the performance advantages of CFlowNets compared to many reinforcement learning methods. Especially in the exploration ability, the effect of CFlowNets far exceeds other state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithms.
translation: 本文提出了生成连续流网络以增强连续控制任务中的探索能力。首先介绍了CFlowNets的理论公式，然后提出了CFlowNets的训练框架，包括动作选择过程、流近似算法以及连续流匹配损失函数。理论分析表明，随着流样本数量的增加，流近似的误差迅速减小。实验结果表明，在连续控制任务中，CFlowNets相比许多强化学习方法具有性能优势，尤其是在探索能力方面，CFlowNets的效果远远超过其他最先进强化学习算法。

source: Limitations:
translation: 局限性：

source: Similar to GFlowNets, CFlowNets aims to sample actions according to the ﬂow network, rather than selecting actions with maximizing rewards. Therefore, CFlowNets are more suitable for exploration-biased tasks. It does not perform as well as reinforcement learning on tasks that aim to maximize reward. Of course, the purpose of CFlowNets is not to completely replace reinforcement learning, but as a supplement to reinforcement learning, giving a new option for continuous control tasks. Future work: Future work will be how to combine CFlowNets with DB and TB objective functions to improve training efﬁciency.
translation: 与GFlowNets类似，CFlowNets旨在根据流网络进行动作采样，而不是选择最大化奖励的动作。因此，CFlowNets更适合于偏向探索的任务。在旨在最大化奖励的任务上，CFlowNets的表现不如强化学习。当然，CFlowNets的目的不是完全取代强化学习，而是作为强化学习的补充，为连续控制任务提供一个新的选项。未来工作：未来的工作将是如何结合CFlowNets与DB和TB目标函数以提高训练效率。

source: As shown in Figures 7, 8 and 9, we provide the visualization of Point-Robot-Sparse, Reacher-Goal- Sparse, and Swimmer-Sparse tasks. In Point-Robot-Sparse, the goal of the agent is to navigate two different goals. The agent starts at the starting coordinate⟦0⟧ and moves towards the target coordinate one step at a time. The environment has two target coordinates⟦1⟧ and⟦2⟧ with a maximum episode length of 12, and the environment returns a reward only when the last step is reached. Rewards are issued by measuring the distance between the agent’s current position and the target node, and the closer the distance, the greater the reward. Each time the agent can take a step from any angle to the upper right.
translation: 如图7、8和9所示，我们提供了Point-Robot-Sparse、Reacher-Goal-Sparse和Swimmer-Sparse任务的可视化。在Point-Robot-Sparse中，代理的目标是在两个不同的目标之间导航。代理从起始坐标⟦0⟧开始，每次移动一步向目标坐标前进。环境有两个目标坐标⟦1⟧和⟦2⟧，最大回合长度为12，仅当最后一步到达时环境才返回奖励。奖励通过测量代理当前位置与目标节点之间的距离来发放，距离越近，奖励越大。每次代理可以从任意角度向上右方向迈出一步。

translation: Reacher-Goal-Sparse和Swimmer-Sparse都改编自OpenAI Gym的MuJoCo环境。在Reacher-Goal-Sparse中，“Reacher”是一个两关节的机械臂。代理的目标是通过移动机器人的末端执行器来达到随机生成的目标。图8显示了机械臂的运动过程。通过调整铰链关节处施加的扭矩，末端执行器可以逐渐接近目标。在Swimmer-Sparse中，“swimmer”悬停在一个
